name: Pordenone (Italy)
description: Vertical tricolour of red, white and red.
history: Municipal flag of Pordenone, a comune in Friuli Venezia Giulia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 19 February 1942.
